Hello! I am originally from China and am currently pursuing my Master of Data Science at the University of British Columbia. 
Prior to joining MDS, I completed my undergraduate studies in Information Management and Information Systems across Shanghai Ocean University and the University of Tasmania. 
I decided to enter the field of data science to sharpen my analytical skills and gain hands-on experience in solving complex, real-world problems.
